acceptanceMapping.source: README S066: Reconcile uncertain outcomes without applying a transaction twice.
acceptanceMapping.behavior: Failover loses all commit acknowledgements; authoritative reconciliation precedes recovery. Safe recovery reuses committed receipts, retries only confirmed aborts with the original operation key and unchanged payload, and holds unresolved outcomes.
checks: browser.test.cjs: lost acknowledgements and reconciled original outcomes

acceptanceMapping.source: D-S066: Retries do not duplicate effects.
acceptanceMapping.behavior: All three safe-policy configurations have zero duplicate effects; complete receipts yield three known effects. Unsafe fresh-key comparison exposes one or two duplicate effects and fails the gate.
checks: browser.test.cjs: UNKNOWN, PASS and known-duplicate FAIL paths

acceptanceMapping.source: D-S066: committed, failed, and unresolved outcomes are attributed honestly.
acceptanceMapping.behavior: Original and recovered attribution are separate and include all three operations. A terminal abort is not a missing lookup. Missing evidence stays unresolved, failure dominates uncertainty, and original failures/three interrupted responses remain after successful recovery.
checks: model.test.cjs: separate prediction verifier and retained history

cleanup.lessonHistory: In-memory, bounded at six attempts, explicit reset/reload clears.
